title: Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit Signing Cushion by Closing Method
content:
**Signing cushion — Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit extensions**

The signing cushion follows the closing method of the scheduled closing under the borrower's Closing and Funding engagement, and it adds its days to the days a Hometown Heroes extension must cover.

| Closing method of the scheduled closing | Signing cushion |
|---|---|
| Larkspur Hybrid eClosing | 10 days |
| Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing | 10 days |
| Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing | 7 days |
| Larkspur Mail-Away Closing | 7 days |
| any other closing method | none |

**Clause.** A Hybrid eClosing or Remote Online Notarization Closing adds 10 days, a Mobile Notary Closing or Mail-Away Closing adds 7 days, and any other closing method adds none.

### Cases (hypothetical)

- Scheduled closing by Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing, 20 calendar days from the credit's expiration date to the target closing date: the cushion brings the count to 30 days.
- Scheduled closing by Larkspur Mail-Away Closing: 7 days are added.
- Scheduled closing by Larkspur Traditional Wet Closing: no cushion.
